title: IFMZ-WRABWZ - EOCR-iFMZ digital motor protection relay with ground fault, 0.5–60 A (direct), 24 V AC/DC (±5 %), Window type (flush mounting)
range_short_desc: Digital motor protection relay with ground-fault protection and Modbus communication
description: EOCR-iFMZ digital motor protection relay from the Samwha EOCR i-Series, with over-current, under-current, phase loss, phase reversal, locked-rotor, imbalance and ground-fault (GF) protection. Measured 3-phase currents and earth-leakage current are shown on a 5-digit 7-segment LED display, with Modbus RS-485 communication. This variant: current range 0.5–60 A (direct), output contact type A — a(97-98): OC, a(57-58): GR, control voltage 24 V AC/DC (±5 %), Window type (flush mounting).

items: Integrated model with improved functions over the FMZ series it replaces
